title: Storage-Aware Expiry
summary: Plan what to use first with dates that change by storage place.
user: A household tracking pantry, fridge, and freezer stock without full grocery accounting.
smallest_useful_product: Offline item cards with storage place, frozen-on date, shelf-life presets, a use-first queue, and printable freezer labels.
constraints: Dates are planning reminders, not food-safety advice.
All inventory data stays in the browser.
Labels print through the browser in v1.
